sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether a party can win attorney fees after a court order changes a policy. The lower court denied fees because no judgment or consent decree existed. the sides that brought the case argue the catalyst theory allows fees for any effective change. the opposing sides argue fees require a formal court order.
